evidence.title: GitHub - arevalolance/design-system-template: 🎨 Design System Starter · GitHub

name: Design System Starter
summary: Turborepo monorepo starter for a design system: shared shadcn/ui React package, Storybook workshop, Next.js apps.
description: A Turborepo starter for building a design system: a shared ui package — a stub React component library with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui already included — consumed by a Storybook workshop app, a Next.js docs app and a Next.js web app. Shared eslint-config-custom, tailwind-config and tsconfig packages round it out; every package and app is 100% TypeScript.
contains: Turborepo with Storybook workshop, Next.js docs app and Next.js web app
ui package: stub React component library with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui included
packages/ui built to dist/ and consumed by the apps
100% TypeScript; ESLint and Prettier set up
